mutation_policy: never overwrite this version; corrections, companion data, identity changes, or source revisions require a new version or explicit amendment with ancestry to CORE-DATASET-FREEZE-V1
outcome_quarantine: event-time inputs and outcome/validation artifacts remain physically/logically separated; no outcome artifact is bound to this freeze
